They have not passed ordinary source/kernel admission and do not establish end-to-end seen-map or traversal-order invariants.

Existing CLoad replaces the whole asset/material context, so actual integration must coherently load all Plan.requests and admit the candidate before updating committed inventory.
Material layer normalization, collisions, budget and per-sprite coverage remain loader checks; planning merely preserves caller BR.Policy.
Loaded ledger checks compare family-name membership, not committed-mode equality or completeness of unobserved family states; those are coherent-catalog preconditions.
